answer: Each identity must build one haven on a reef, anchored by a spiral of pairing bonds: the k-th haven needs the k-th telephone number of bonds (1, 2, 4, 10, 26, 76, 232, 764, 2,620, 9,496), so ten pay 13,231 and the tenth 9,496, more than the first nine combined. Each haven waits one season per earlier haven before its reef anchor sets, so the hundredth fake waits 99 seasons.
